title: Readiness checklist & governance matrix for isolated tenancies
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a concise, actionable readiness checklist and governance matrix to be used by Sales/CS/SEs and Engineering when onboarding or upgrading isolated tenant (Private/VPC/on‑prem) customers. The artifact will translate quarterly roadmap milestones into deterministic acceptance gates: networking & routing, KMS/HSM integration, audit & exportable logs, upgrade windows & rollback plan, capacity/throughput verification, SLO acceptance, and compliance attestations. Goal: reduce onboarding time and failed rollouts by establishing clear pass/fail criteria and owner responsibilities for each gate.
acceptance_criteria: A single checklist document exists with discrete gates and binary pass/fail criteria
Each gate has an owner (PM/Eng/SE/Customer) and clear verification steps
Governance matrix maps customers to required gates based on risk tier (L1/L2/L3)
Automated verification hooks where possible (k8s smoke tests, infra checks, log export validation)
Runbook references for rollback and incident playbooks linked from the checklist
Stakeholder sign-off (SE lead, Security, Customer Success) documented for pilot cohort
comments: 2025-02-11 — Kickoff with Eng/SE/Compliance: agreed to focus first on 'Network/Connectivity', 'KMS', 'Audit Logging', 'Upgrade/rollback' gates. Action: Eng to draft verification scripts for connectivity and log exports (ENG-1842).

2025-02-14 — Security feedback (Maya Singh): add explicit HSM cert rotation check and key export prohibition test. Marked as security_review_required. Updated acceptance criteria to include KMS verification steps.

2025-02-17 — SE feedback (Diego Alvarez): suggested adding 'customer preflight' checklist for onprem sites (local port checks, NTP sync, kernel modules). Added as optional L2 gate for onprem installs.
2025-02-19 — PM sync: decided governance matrix will use 3 risk tiers (Standard, Regulated, Air‑gapped) mapped to gates and required signatures. CS to propose pilot customers for Q1 trial.

2025-02-21 — Engineering note (Ravi): prototyped k8s smoke test that validates model serving path and KV cache warmup; results stored in dashboard 'private-readiness/pilot-01' (link below). Need to add tokenized evidence collection for customer acceptance.

2025-02-24 — Design review (Leah): recommended a one‑page executive checklist and a detailed appendix for engineers. Will produce two artifacts: a one‑page checklist PDF and a Confluence checklist with runbook links.
2025-02-25 — Next steps: finalize gating criteria doc, implement 3 automated checks (connectivity, KMS sign/verify, log export), and schedule pilot with SEs for week of 2025-03-10.
notes: Trade-offs: heavier verification reduces rollout speed but lowers failure rate. We will gate only the highest risk customers (Regulated/Air‑gapped) on strict checks initially.
Partial decision: initial rollout will treat 'capacity/throughput verification' as advisory for Standard customers, required for Regulated customers.
Risk: on‑prem environments have diverse networking constraints — include a fallback lighter 'connectivity handshake' for edge cases.
Follow-up task: create templated evidence bundle format so SEs can upload verification artifacts into the customer record.
